messages:
anya: Quick heads-up 1: I'm putting together the release notes + changelog entry for next Tuesday's docs deploy. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1231. Can we confirm the final list of user-visible items?

kevin: Items from my side: (1) new routing banner (marketing copy ready), (2) embeddings param rename `dedupe` -> `filter_duplicates` in the API spec (we added an alias but default changed). Linked: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/api/pull/1003. Need a short migration note.

josh: Also raise: the Node SDK v1.6.0 changes streaming callback semantics for `onData(null)` vs `onData("")` - docs snippet should show guard `if (chunk?.text?.trim())` to avoid logging blanks. Filed SDK issue: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/sdk/issues/430.

anya: Good. Can you paste a one-line wording for the changelog for both of those? We want consumer-friendly + a technical footnote in known-issues.

kevin: One-liners: "Embeddings API: `filter_duplicates` (alias `dedupe`) default now false; set `filter_duplicates=true` to preserve legacy dedupe behavior." Short and actionable.

josh: One-liner: "Node SDK: streaming may emit empty chunks at end-of-stream. Filter `chunk.text` to skip blanks (see SDK issue #430)."

lex: CI note 1: docs build flakes on anchors in our Gatsby pipeline when JS deps are mismatched. I opened docs CI ticket 236. If docs-ci fails, we might have to cut the site deploy manually (I can do that).

anya: Thanks. For the changelog format I'm planning to add: `docs/changelog/2025-11-11.md` with YAML frontmatter and bullets. Example entry I'm going to add:

```yaml
---
date: 2025-11-11
version: docs-release-2025-11-11
---
- Added: smarter routing banner and rollout controls.
- Changed: Embeddings API default deduplication behavior (see migration note).
- Fixed: SDK snippet updates for streaming guards (Node + Python).
```

anya: Also adding a Known Issues snippet to `docs/releases/known-issues.md`: short items for streaming empty chunk, autoscale variant latency, and docs anchor flakiness.

kevin: For migration guide, suggest small code example for embedding creation. Sample:```js
const {Client} = require('@redwood/sdk');
const c = new Client();
await c.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-1', input: ['a','b'], filter_duplicates: true});
```
Include note: `filter_duplicates` is preferred but `dedupe` alias still accepted until 2026-01-01.

josh: I'll open the SDK README PR to include the guard snippets and link to SDK issue 430. Assigning to @anya for review.

docs-ci: docs build queued. Running tests + anchor checks (node 20).

lex: Release window reminder: 2025-11-11 18:00 UTC. If docs-ci green by -4h we auto-deploy. If it fails, I'll coordinate manual push with infra.

anya: Action list: (1) kevin to add migration blurb and API link in PR 1231, (2) josh to update Node SDK snippet and open PR, (3) Ill update `changelog/2025-11-11.md` and `releases/known-issues.md`, (4) lex will monitor docs-ci and standby for manual deploy. Ping here when PRs are up. :thumbsup:

kevin: Will do. PR comment coming in ~45m.

josh: PR for SDK snippets in 15m.

docs-ci: build started (job id: 99877).
